instruction: Finish the task with command-line or batch-capable tools from Altium Designer, OrCAD Capture, or OpenSCAD. The neutral schematic package `tutor2` is on the desktop. Export a primitive part pin map to `pin_map.json`. Requirements: - `pin_map.json` must contain `total_parts`, `total_pins`, and sorted `parts`. - Each part must include `ref`, `pin_count`, and sorted `pin_numbers`. - `total_pins` must equal the sum of the part pin counts. [Software] The available entry points are OrCAD Capture at `C:\Cadence\SPB_24.1\tools\bin\Capture.exe`, Altium Designer at `C:\Program Files (x86)\Altium\AD17\DXP.EXE`, and OpenSCAD at `C:\Program Files\OpenSCAD\openscad.exe`. Save the required deliverables into `C:\Users\user\Desktop\result`.
